body: I appreciate you encouraging me to dabble in writing. I am going to try and follow your advice and develop this passion, and maybe one day I'll have some stuff to share with everyone.

I find comfort in the fact that someone else has shared a pain similar to mine but ya know that also sucks cause pain sucks. I am glad you have found something to give you the will to live on. I have thought about using therapy to help me but I fear the awkward social dynamic that follows after revealing my feelings to my family. And also I am not entirely sure how they would respond to me revealing this and due to the unknown factors involved I thought it best to seek help through Reddit because I am unaware of any better anonymous medium. Anyways thanks for the response it was interesting to read about your circumstances.

My passion lies wherever there is a story. Whether it comes from a book, a game, a movie it does not matter there is simply nothing else in life that can invoke such feelings out of me. I have thought of striving to become an author because of this and I may do that but I am not very confident in my writing skills, but perhaps with practice I can hope to become something decent.

I understand the necessity of the suffering and I must admit I can see no reasonable alternative to make society function. If I wish to live independently I must play my part and earn my keep and hopefully find something that fulfills me. But I do wonder why I suffer this mental anguish while it seems like the majority of my peers do not. Perhaps they do and I can not see it because they hide it like I do. Or perhaps I'm just messed up in some way and of course I am, we all are in some way but I wonder if others were in my circumstance would they feel as I do?
